title: Stroke and Systemic Embolism Prevention in Participants with Atrial Fibrillation
official: A Phase 3, Randomized, Multicenter, Double-blind Study to Assess Stroke and Systemic Embolism Prevention with REGN7508, a Monoclonal Antibody Against Factor XI, Versus Apixaban in Participants with Atrial Fibrillation (ROXI-EVEREST)
summary:
Main objective: To evaluate the effect of REGN7508 on the risk of stroke or systemic embolism compared to apixaban
To evaluate the effect of REGN7508 on the risk of clinically relevant bleeding compared to apixaban
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Has AF or flutter (paroxysmal or persistent), not considered to be secondary to a reversible cause, and an indication for indefinite anticoagulation treatment as described in the protocol
2. Meets one of the following:  a. CHA2DS2-VA [C: Congestive heart failure; H: Hypertension; A2: Age ≥75 years (double points); D: Diabetes mellitus; S2: Stroke or TIA or Systemic embolism (double points); V: Vascular disease; A: Age 65-74 years] score ≥2 and Oral Anticoagulant (OAC) naïve OR  b. CHA2DS2-VA score ≥3 OR  c. CHA2DS2-VA score of 2 AND at least 1 enrichment criteria as described in the protocol
3. Must have an International Normalized Ratio (INR) <2.5 at the time of randomization if taking warfarin or another Vitamin K Antagonist (VKA)
4. Note: Other protocol-defined Inclusion criteria apply
Exclusion criteria:
1. Has a mechanical heart valve prosthesis (Note: transcatheter aortic valve replacement is not an exclusion)
2. Has known moderate-to-severe mitral stenosis
3. Has had a successful ablation therapy without documented recurrent AF or a participant after Left Atrial Appendage (LAA) occlusion/exclusion or plan for ablation or LAA occlusion/exclusion within the next 6 months starting from randomization
4. Had an ischemic stroke within 2 days prior to randomization
5. Has persistent, uncontrolled hypertension (per investigator’s discretion)
6. Has estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR) <15 mL/min/1.73m2 within 30 days prior to randomization or is on dialysis or expected to be started on dialysis within the next 6 months starting from randomization
7. Note: Other protocol-defined Exclusion criteria apply
